a: Raster images are pixels (PNG/JPEG); vector images are shapes (SVG) that scale cleanly.
JPEG is lossy good for photos; PNG is lossless and supports transparency.
WebP is a modern image format with strong compression for the web.
SVG is XML-based vector graphics ideal for icons and illustrations.
srcset and sizes serve different image resolutions based on device.
Codecs like H.264/AV1 compress video; containers (MP4/WebM) hold streams.
Serve media via CDN for lower latency and offloaded bandwidth.
Compress, resize, lazy-load, and choose modern formats for faster pages.
EXIF metadata can include camera settings and GPS — strip if privacy-sensitive.
OCR extracts text from images of documents.
